parameters.name: AlertGroup
parameters.description:
The alert contact group. Only one alert contact group is supported.

> This parameter is required when you update the instance for the first time. It is optional for subsequent updates.

parameters.name: CnameCustomDomainName
parameters.description: This parameter is required when you set **CnameMode** to **CUSTOM**. The value must be the primary domain name.

parameters.name: CnameMode
parameters.description:
The connection type. Valid values:

- **SYSTEM\_ASSIGN**: system-assigned

- **CUSTOM**: custom

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the GTM instance.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description:
The name of the instance.

> This parameter is required when you update the instance for the first time. It is optional for subsequent updates.

parameters.name: LbaStrategy
parameters.description:
The load balancing policy. Valid values:

- **ALL\_RR**: round-robin

- **RATIO**: weighted round-robin

> This parameter is required when you update the instance for the first time. It is optional for subsequent updates.

parameters.name: UserDomainName
parameters.description:
The primary domain name.

> This parameter is required when you update the instance for the first time. It is optional for subsequent updates.
